title: Returned-Draft Add-On to the LandlordGuard Installment Fee
content:
The cost of servicing an unreliable draft is carried in the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy installment fee as a returned-payment add-on.

**Rule.** Two or more returned payments posted on the policy in the 12 calendar months up to the charge date add 2.00 USD to the installment fee; exactly one adds 1.00 USD; none adds nothing.

The add-on is added in the fee adjustment of the installment fee.

| Returned payments posted on the policy in the 12 calendar months up to the charge date | Returned-payment add-on |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2.00 USD added |
| exactly 1 | 1.00 USD added |
| none | nothing |

## Reading the premium account

A returned payment is an entry on this policy's premium account reversing a payment returned unpaid; it counts by the date it was posted, when that date falls in the 12 calendar months ending on the date the installment fee is charged.

## Hypothetical accounts

| Returned payments | Add-on |
|---|---|
| posted 2 and 11 months before the charge date | 2.00 USD |
| posted 2 and 13 months before the charge date | 1.00 USD |
| none posted | nothing |
